answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fakes at the inlet of the task market. To claim a slot, an agent burns 600 POA, twice 30-day earnings. A quill-signed receipt frees the slot only after peers verify the work; junk forfeits it. Forging 100 identities costs 60,000 POA with no refund, while one honest agent pays 600 POA once and earns it back. A nebula of unverified accounts cannot share a deposit: each burn ties to one identity and one receipt.
